name: Surface
tagline: Unwraps short links and tells an AI agent fetch or skip before it opens them.
description: Surface unwraps short links and tells your AI agent fetch or skip before it opens them. Its preflight_url tool follows redirects, refuses private hosts, and returns the final URL with a fetch or skip verdict. It never returns the page body. Agents can call the HTTP API (POST https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/v1/preflight) or the remote MCP server at https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/mcp. Front door: https://otter-sand-wolf-spring.grok.me. Free up to 1M requests a month.
